title: Aspartate aminotransferase from another date reclassifies FibroScan-AST more often than Agile: reference change values identify results at risk: analysis code and aggregate results
description: Analysis code and aggregate results for a laboratory study of the FibroScan-aspartate aminotransferase (FAST) score. In 5,077 vibration-controlled transient elastography scans from 3,427 patients linked to laboratory records, FAST calculated with the nearest earlier or later AST (90 days or less) was compared with FAST from same-day AST for the same scan; the comparison was repeated for Agile 3+, Agile 4 and FIB-4, and a reporting flag based on the reference change value (RCV) of AST was evaluated and compared with simpler rules. Patient-level data are not included; the aggregate result tables behind every number in the manuscript are provided. Version 1.1.2 accompanies the Clinical Biochemistry submission; analysis scripts and results are unchanged from v1.1.0.
